ImageDescription.value: Bunratty Castle. The castle and folk park seem to be a big tourist attraction.  The castle was restored and given to the Irish State.  The folk park has a collection of buildings from various places notably where Shannon airport was built.  Loads of thatched houses with peat fires, and a host of shops.
